name: leaf_poisson_index_shift
code:
/-- P0082 page 356, adjacent frequency reduction in the Poisson display.
Exact clean companion for the open index leaf. -/
theorem leaf_poisson_index_shift (v : ℝ) (m : ℤ) :
    v + (m : ℝ) = Int.fract v + ((m + ⌊v⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
  simp only [Int.fract, Int.cast_add]
  ring
twin: An integer translate v plus m is fract v plus the integer m plus floor v.
instance: Take v equal to minus 1/2 and m one. Both expressions are 1/2.

name: leaf_poisson_index_ne_zero
code:
/-- P0082 page 356, adjacent frequency reduction in the Poisson display.
Exact clean companion for the open index leaf. -/
theorem leaf_poisson_index_ne_zero (v : ℝ) (m : ℤ) (hm : m ≠ -⌊v⌋) :
    m + ⌊v⌋ ≠ 0 := by
  omega
twin: Excluding m equal to minus floor v excludes m plus floor v equal to zero.
instance: Take v 1/2 and m one. The shifted integer is one.

name: leaf_poisson_index_ne_neg_one
code:
/-- P0082 page 356, adjacent frequency reduction in the Poisson display.
Exact clean companion for the open index leaf. -/
theorem leaf_poisson_index_ne_neg_one (v : ℝ) (m : ℤ) (hm : m ≠ -(⌊v⌋ + 1)) :
    m + ⌊v⌋ ≠ -1 := by
  omega
twin: Excluding m equal to minus the successor of floor v excludes m plus floor v equal to minus one.
instance: Take v 1/2 and m one. The shifted integer is one.

name: leaf_poisson_index_dichotomy
code:
/-- P0082 page 356, adjacent frequency reduction in the Poisson display.
Exact clean companion for the open index leaf. -/
theorem leaf_poisson_index_dichotomy (k : ℤ) (h0 : k ≠ 0) (h1 : k ≠ -1) :
    1 ≤ k ∨ k ≤ -2 := by
  omega
twin: An integer other than zero and minus one is at least one or at most minus two.
instance: Take k one for the first branch and k minus two for the second.

name: leaf_poisson_index_upper
code:
/-- P0082 page 356, adjacent frequency reduction in the Poisson display.
Exact clean companion for the open index leaf. -/
theorem leaf_poisson_index_upper (v : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    1 ≤ |Int.fract v + (k : ℝ)| := by
  have hk' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  exact (by linarith [Int.fract_nonneg v] : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Int.fract v + (k : ℝ)).trans
    (le_abs_self _)
twin: Adding an integer at least one to a fractional part has absolute value at least one.
instance: Take v 1/2 and k one. The absolute value is 3/2.

name: leaf_poisson_index_lower
code:
/-- P0082 page 356, adjacent frequency reduction in the Poisson display.
Exact clean companion for the open index leaf. -/
theorem leaf_poisson_index_lower (v : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≤ -2) :
    1 ≤ |Int.fract v + (k : ℝ)| := by
  have hk' : (k : ℝ) ≤ -2 := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hneg : Int.fract v + (k : ℝ) ≤ -1 := by linarith [Int.fract_lt_one v]
  calc (1 : ℝ) ≤ -(Int.fract v + (k : ℝ)) := by linarith
    _ ≤ |Int.fract v + (k : ℝ)| := neg_le_abs _
twin: Adding an integer at most minus two to a fractional part has absolute value at least one.
instance: Take v 1/2 and k minus two. The absolute value is 3/2.
